a1a.palm-beach: Worth Avenue boutiques, oceanfront estates and old-school glamour.
a1a.boca-raton: Mizner Park, wide public beaches and golf resorts.
a1a.fort-lauderdale: Las Olas Boulevard, canals and the world’s largest in-water boat show.
a1a.hollywood: The Broadwalk promenade and the Guitar Hotel at Seminole Hard Rock.
a1a.aventura: Aventura Mall, waterfront dining and quiet residential towers.
a1a.miami-gardens: Hard Rock Stadium: Dolphins games, the Miami Open and the Formula 1 Grand Prix.
a1a.sunny-isles: Oceanfront towers and calm beaches. Our garage is here, so the fleet starts at this stop.
a1a.bal-harbour: Bal Harbour Shops and an unhurried, upscale stretch of sand.
a1a.mid-beach: The Fontainebleau, LIV and the beachfront boardwalk.
a1a.south-beach: Ocean Drive Art Deco, Lincoln Road and the lifeguard towers of Lummus Park.
a1a.islands: Private islands and the marinas where most of our charters board.
a1a.downtown: Bayfront Park, the Heat at Kaseya Center, PortMiami and late nights at E11EVEN.
a1a.wynwood: Wynwood Walls, galleries and breweries. Busiest during Art Week.
a1a.design-district: Luxury flagships, design galleries and the ICA Miami.
a1a.brickell: Financial-district towers, rooftop bars and dinner at Komodo.
a1a.little-havana: Calle Ocho, Cuban coffee windows and Domino Park.
a1a.coral-gables: Mediterranean Revival streets, the Biltmore and the Venetian Pool.
a1a.coconut-grove: Bayfront marinas, banyan trees and long lunches.
a1a.key-biscayne: Crandon Park beaches and the Cape Florida lighthouse.
a1a.key-largo: The first of the Keys and John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park.
a1a.key-west: Duval Street and sunset at Mallory Square.
